name: Puzzle
summary: Puzzle is accounting software for startups that runs cash and accrual books on one real-time ledger. It connects to bank and card accounts through Plaid and prepares financial statements for investors. Plans run from $30 a month for one seat to $360, and AI-prepared reconciliations start on the $120 Complete plan.

facts.text: Puzzle says it connects to 12,000+ banks and cards through Plaid and syncs direct integrations daily.
AI-powered reconciliations are listed from the Complete plan upward, and custom chart of accounts from Core, per the pricing page.
An Expert Reviewed add-on, where a bookkeeper checks reconciliations, costs $171 a month for up to $10,000 in monthly expenses.
Yearly billing is offered as 12 months for the price of 10.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1 seat. Cash and accrual books, unlimited connections, auto-drafted financial statements

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: 5 seats. Adds advanced reporting and custom chart of accounts

plans.name: Complete
plans.notes: Unlimited seats. Adds AI-powered reconciliations and accuracy review

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Unlimited seats. Adds subledgers, no transaction limits and 300 AI credits a month

hiddenCosts: AI-prepared reconciliations are not on Starter or Core.
Expert Reviewed bookkeeping is $171 a month on top of a Core plan, and Full Service is priced by an expense slider with no figures shown.
